query: SELECT weekNumber, weekStartDate, SUM(CAST(total AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as week_total, SUM(donationCount) as total_donations FROM giving_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber >= 15 GROUP BY weekNumber, weekStartDate ORDER BY weekNumber;
